name: Pretzels

high.description: About 1 small pretzel or 6-8 mini pretzels

siboNotes: High fructan content makes pretzels problematic for SIBO patients. Even small amounts can trigger symptoms due to wheat-based fructans.
preparationTips: Check ingredient lists for added garlic or onion powder
Look for gluten-free varieties made with rice or corn flour
Consider making homemade versions with gluten-free flours
Be mindful of flavored varieties which may contain additional FODMAPs
nutritionalHighlights: Contains B vitamins from wheat flour
